hs_revision: HS 2022 (WCO 6-digit, as returned by UN Comtrade's H6 classification)
source: Live-verified 2026-08-21 for the Global Trade / Customs Intelligence V1 mission against UN Comtrade's public preview API (classificationCode: H6) and cross-checked against published HS/HTS reference tables.
notes: 6-digit HS codes are identical across every WCO member country; national tariff schedules (e.g. US HTS, 10-digit) sometimes add berry-specific breakouts that the 6-digit level does not have. This project's chosen adapter (UN Comtrade) reports at the 6-digit (H6) level, so every limitation below is real and load-bearing, not a hypothetical caveat.

codes.limitations: None found -- strawberry is cleanly separable at 6 digits, both fresh and frozen.

codes.description: Strawberries, frozen (whether or not cooked by steaming/boiling in water, whether or not sweetened)
Raspberries, blackberries, mulberries and loganberries, fresh
codes.limitations: Raspberry and blackberry are NOT separable at the 6-digit level -- this single code also includes mulberries and loganberries (neither tracked by this platform). Any quantity/value reported here is a combined figure across at least 4 real fruit types. Do not attribute a change in this code to either raspberry or blackberry specifically without a corroborating qualitative source.

codes.description: Raspberries, blackberries, mulberries, loganberries, black/white/red currants and gooseberries, frozen
codes.limitations: Same combination problem as 081020, plus currants and gooseberries (neither tracked). Even less berry-specific than the fresh code.

codes.description: Cranberries, blueberries and other fruit of the genus Vaccinium, fresh
codes.limitations: Blueberry is NOT cleanly separable from cranberries, bilberries, and other Vaccinium species at the 6-digit level. For the countries this pilot actually queried (Mexico, Peru, Chile, Morocco, South Africa -> US/UK), fresh commercial cranberry trade in these specific bilateral flows is understood to be minor relative to blueberry (cranberries are predominantly a US/Canada domestic and North-American-sourced crop), but this is a real, undemonstrated assumption, not a verified fact -- flagged as debt (TD-TRADE-002), not silently treated as if the code were blueberry-exclusive.

codes.description: Other fruit and nuts (n.e.s.), frozen -- includes frozen blueberries at the 6-digit level, but is NOT a blueberry-specific code
codes.limitations: This is a real, significant limitation, more severe than 081040: 081190 is a genuine 'other fruit, frozen, not elsewhere specified' basket that includes frozen blueberries alongside many unrelated frozen fruits (only the US's own 10-digit HTS extension, 0811.90.20, isolates frozen blueberries specifically -- UN Comtrade's 6-digit H6 classification does not). Frozen-berry trade-flow figures at this code should be treated as directional/contextual only, never as a blueberry-specific quantity, unless corroborated by a national 10-digit source this mission did not integrate.
